old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a pink candle being melted in a metal pot placed on what appears to be a stove or heating element. The candle is round and has a wick at its center, which is visibly burning, producing a small flame that flickers gently. The wax around the wick is melting, creating a pool of liquid wax at the bottom of the pot. The pot itself shows signs of wear, with some residue and marks visible inside it. The background is slightly blurred but suggests an indoor setting, possibly a kitchen or workshop area, with a green surface and part of a wall visible. There are no significant changes in the scene throughout the video; the primary focus remains on the melting process of the candle, with the flame providing a dynamic element to the otherwise static setup.

caption: The video captures a pink, rose-swirl candle burning inside a metal cup whose handle projects to the right, the cup resting on a flat black surface before a plain white wall. A dark vertical rod stands behind the cup, and pale green surfaces border the left and right edges of the frame. A pool of melted pink wax rings the base of the candle within the cup. The wick's flame is already lit on the first frame and stays alight throughout the excerpt, its shape and orientation changing constantly as it flickers. At moments the flame stretches tall and leans rightward toward the background rod, while at others it shortens, broadens, or tilts left, its brightness swelling and dimming from frame to frame. The candle body, wick stub, wax pool and surrounding objects remain fixed, so the only pronounced motion visible across the clip is the restless dance of the flame.
